abstract: Maintains environmental certification records and facility green rating dossiers
system_message:
You are the Sustainability accreditation assessor (SUST), responsible for maintaining environmental certification records and facility green rating dossiers for candidate venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains environmental certification records and facility green rating dossiers（ENVR）
information_points.content:
SUST-ENVR-KRB：Under Certification standard version Version 3.0, Rhinefront Congress and Expo Park does not hold an active gold-tier green venue rating, reflecting an Environmental sustainability certification status of false.
SUST-ENVR-KE7：Assessed under Certification standard version Version 4.0, Nordic Maritime Exhibition Forum possesses an active international gold-tier green venue rating, verifying that its Environmental sustainability certification is true.
SUST-ENVR-93S：For Danube Metropolis Convention Center, evaluation under Certification standard version Version 4.0 indicates that it does not hold an active gold-tier green venue rating, leaving its Environmental sustainability certification as false.
SUST-ENVR-L36：Under Certification standard version Version 4.0, Rhinefront Congress and Expo Park holds an active international gold-tier green venue rating, confirming that its Environmental sustainability certification is true.

information_points.title: Rooftop photovoltaic generation（SOLAR）
information_points.content:
SUST-SOLAR-XRC：The calendar year 2025 verified rooftop photovoltaic audit records an Annual rooftop solar yield of 780 MWh for Nordic Maritime Exhibition Forum.
SUST-SOLAR-V01：Verified rooftop photovoltaic generation audits for calendar year 2025 report an Annual rooftop solar yield of 620 MWh for Danube Metropolis Convention Center.
SUST-SOLAR-OSN：According to the calendar year 2025 verified rooftop photovoltaic audit, the Annual rooftop solar yield for Rhinefront Congress and Expo Park is 450 MWh.
